paragraphs.text: The scorecard's gaps generate the work (check: cmd/loop TestScorecardGapsBecomeProposals, cmd/loop TestTheGapsAreFiledOnceTheScorecardPublishes, cmd/loop TestADeclineBecomesTheRowTheLoopWorks). There is no passed state and no promotion (check: cmd/gate TestCompletionAuthorityGone, internal/plan TestLivePlanRejectsRetainedCompletionState).

A change grows production code no more than its row's count, so a consolidation pays for what it adds with what it deletes (check: internal/landing TestItemsGrowthIsChargedAcrossItsLandings, internal/landing TestWrittenCodeIsCountedByKind). A new export has a consumer outside its package (check: internal/landing TestExportUseCountsConsumers).

One run serves every obligation whose identity and contract match, written once as one record with many readers (check: cmd/loop TestMeasurementRunsNoCaseAgainAfterAnUnrelatedCommit, internal/evaluation TestEvaluationAtAnUnchangedPlanReusesItsCampaign, internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity). A run never judges what it produced (check: internal/runrecord TestProposerEvaluatorDeciderAuthorityDomainsAndPriorGeneration, internal/trainingworkflow TestHeldoutRunTrainsOnlyOnTrainingRecords, internal/runrecord TestTrainingDecisionWithholdsPromotionUntilEvaluation). Every contract a comparison reads and every retained protocol is a cell the cycle runs (check: cmd/validate TestEveryComparedContractHasACell, cmd/validate TestCycleRunsWhatPromotionCompares).

The gate's verdict depends only on the tree, and suites that load real models, read the live store or sweep the device run in the cycle's lanes by build tag, never the gate's (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/landing TestLaneSelectionUsesTheLaneBuildContext, internal/landing TestAudioLaneOptsIntoTheStoreAcceptance). The cycle measures at the commit it began at, in its own checkout (check: cmd/loop TestCycleRunsInItsOwnCheckout). A landing's cost is read from its diff, the lanes it reaches through its test binaries' closure and the pinned media it stales (check: internal/landing TestLaneReachSkipsOtherPackagesTests, internal/landing TestPreflightNamesPinnedBytes). A move of the inference surface puts every evaluation bound to it again (check: internal/evaluation TestAnswersOutliveOnlyTheCommitsThatLeaveTheirCodeUnchanged, internal/inferencesurface TestEvaluationIdentityIsItsModelsWithTheSourcesThatAskIt). A cycle starts once the measured surface moved (check: cmd/loop TestLoopStartsACycleWhenTheMeasuredSurfaceMoved). Dependency work is verified through its test closure and the guard surface, which stops at overgodb and runrecord (check: internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceCoversEmbeddedInputsAndModules, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). A suite moved out of the gate still reaches a cycle lane (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/trainingworkflow TestEveryRetiredLifecycleFailureIsStillCaught). The landing scorecard reports and never refuses (check: internal/landing TestLandingMeasuresTheScorecardSlice). The gate writes the numbers a landing message carries (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind).

Before a landing the preflight runs the cheap stages alone, format, fix, vet, rules, invariants and the step's check (check: internal/landing TestPreflightRunsTheCheapStagesOnly, internal/landing TestGeneratorsAreThoseTheRepositoryHas).

Each structural boundary is pinned as a row of its kind's invariant table (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). The gate writes each landing's lanes skipped, lane walls, and packages executed and cached (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestRanPackagesNamesOnlyWhatRan). No fixed timer comes back, nor the deleted baselines and tracking records (check: internal/repoanalysis TestNoFixedTimers, cmd/gate TestClosureLedgerGone, cmd/gate TestGateRecordsGone).

A journey is timed from action to usable result, with loading, waiting, execution and display apart (check: cmd/recipe TestMeasurementSeparatesLoadPrefillAndVisibleOutput, internal/server TestWebUIBrowserShowsTheFirstTokenTime, internal/server TestCancelledDownloadHoldsItsSlotUntilItFinishes). One gate run serves every step it lands (check: internal/landing TestLandingCompletesSeveralSteps). Validation and reuse are scoped by actual dependencies, and one that cannot be named keeps the wider scope (check: internal/inferencesurface TestCapabilityIdentityMovesOnlyWithItsOwnSources, internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity, cmd/validate TestBenchmarkDoesNotReuseUnknownExecution).

A full measurement run continues only at the commit it began at (check: cmd/loop TestUnfinishedCycleContinuesAtItsOwnCommit, cmd/loop TestInterruptedCycleResumesAtItsFirstUnpassedPhase). Landings go on beside a run, waiting only for the device turn, with the checkout free (check: internal/landing TestALandingBesideARunWaitsOnlyForTheDevice, internal/landing TestALandingWaitingOnARunLeavesTheCheckoutFree).

The repository tracks no Python, and its runtime is Go (check: internal/repoanalysis TestPythonLivesOnlyInItsIgnoredPlace, internal/repoanalysis TestRSIRuntimeIsGoOnly). A row's acceptance is fixed before its code, every open step having a check and a change judged by the check its row held before it (check: internal/plan TestOpenStepRequiresVerifier, internal/landing TestChangeIsJudgedByTheTermsItStartedWith). A reader of a record form the store holds stays while the store holds it (check: internal/runrecord TestStageReceiptOfTheEarlierFormIsRead, internal/runrecord TestRetiredGateAliasesAtRest). A pilot not accepted leaves the served path, and its record is kept (check: cmd/train TestPilotKeepsItsRecordBeforeItRemovesItsCheckpoints, internal/trainingworkflow TestRewardAdoptionRequiresDeclaredComparisons, cmd/train TestProposalRetirementPreservesTrainingAndEvidence).

A change grows production code no more than its row's count, read from the commit it builds on, and an item's count covers all its landings (check: internal/landing TestItemsGrowthIsChargedAcrossItsLandings, internal/landing TestChangeIsJudgedByTheTermsItStartedWith). A count is raised with a reason of its own (check: internal/landing TestLandingRaisesItsOwnCount, cmd/plan TestSetCountWritesTheCountAndItsReason). Test code, fixtures, record schemas and CUDA source are reported with each landing and not refused (check: internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind, internal/landing TestWrittenCodeIsCountedByKind).

A stored result is reused only under unchanged identity of code, model, recipe, data, settings and request, and a fresh request always runs (check: internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity, internal/capabilityruntime TestFreshRunExecutesWhatAnIdenticalRequestStored, cmd/validate TestResumedRunStartsAgainACellWhoseWeightsChanged). Eligibility is kept apart from selection, observations from scores, and choosing records from confirming ones (check: internal/trainingworkflow TestSelectionNeverRestoresEligibility, internal/evaluation TestScoringFixRunsNoCaseAgain, internal/evaluation TestConfirmationIsChargedBeforeThePromotionPartIsRead).

An experiment's acceptance is frozen before it trains, from the store's cases and never from its arms (check: internal/evaluation TestInstructionAcceptanceBindsProtocolGroupsAndComparisons, internal/evaluation TestHeldOutPoolIsSizedForItsDeclaredGain, internal/trainingworkflow TestPilotAcceptanceIsFixedFromTheStoresCases). A complete negative or inconclusive record closes an experiment and activates nothing (check: internal/trainingworkflow TestRewardAdoptionRequiresDeclaredComparisons, internal/trainingworkflow TestFirstRewardRunsRecordIsComplete, cmd/train TestPilotKeepsItsRecordBeforeItRemovesItsCheckpoints).

Pinned model_index.json declares MOSSImagePipeline, MOSSImageTransformer, MOSSImageScheduler, Qwen3_5Model, Qwen2Tokenizer and AutoencoderKLFlux2.
The transformer config declares 42 layers, hidden width 3072, FFN width 8192, 24 heads, text width 4096, timestep frequency width 256 and 128 packed latent channels.
The text encoder config declares 32 hybrid linear/full-attention layers with hidden width 4096; reuse Overgo's Qwen3.5 execution where its hidden-state contract matches.
The bundled VAE has 32 latent channels, a 2-by-2 latent patch, batch-normalization statistics and the small decoder widths [96,192,384,384]; the current latentimage QwenImage VAE and selected-layer Qwen3-VL conditioner are not drop-in implementations.
Pinned SFT safetensors sizes are 16785478992 bytes for the text encoder, 10164664216 bytes for the transformer and 249521372 bytes for the VAE: 27199664580 bytes before tokenizer, metadata, runtime buffers or caches.
Only the SFT checkpoint is an acquisition, serving and evaluation target; previously collected Base metadata remains historical reference material.
Resident inference memory is unmeasured and must include activations, attention workspace, decoder buffers, graph allocations and host staging; the 5B marketing size describes the transformer rather than the complete pipeline.

Parity targets the pinned released pipeline, not an unavailable training-time fp32-master implementation.
Default workload uses a CPU generator seeded with 42, 1024-by-1024 output, 50 requested steps, guidance 3, shift 5, empty negative prompt and negative-branch skip index 22.
MOSSImageScheduler snaps shifted sigmas to the nearest training grid and removes consecutive duplicates, so actual step count must come from the resulting schedule.
The pipeline wraps prompts with apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=true), runs individual unpadded encoder forwards with use_cache=false, and consumes last_hidden_state with a true-length mask.
DiT and conditioner use bf16; initial noise, prediction combination, Euler updates and VAE decoding use fp32; timestep sinusoids use fp64 before conversion and RoPE frequencies and phases use fp32.
Dimensions are positive multiples of 16 and prompt maximum length is 4096; preserve or explicitly expose upstream truncation rather than silently rewriting prompts.
Default CFG performs two transformer forwards per step; guidance 1 removes the negative branch.
Optional positive-branch SLG adds another forward and is deferred; unsupported controls must be rejected rather than silently ignored.
Deterministic import means the same pinned bytes and policy produce the same content identities, tensor mappings and recipe; it does not promise GPU bit identity across hardware or library versions.
Freeze numerical tolerance from independently measured oracle repeatability and datatype effects before comparing native outputs; do not widen it to accept a failed port.

Reuse artifact, hfhub, hfrepo, safetensors, tensorcatalog, modelartifact, modelintake, libraryintake and modelrecipe for acquisition, inventory, lifecycle and capability publication.
Extend the existing intake operation and CLI surfaces instead of adding a MOSS-only downloader, registry or serving process.
Keep architecture facts and defaults in versioned artifacts and recipes; implement missing numerical operations in the existing tensor, graph and media owners.
Generalize only where MOSS and a second real supported model demonstrate the same contract; preserve distinct conditioner, transformer, scheduler and decoder semantics.
Apply the broader Strata direction through exact dependency identities, stage-local execution, bounded residency and reuse of valid intermediate results, without inventing a parallel graph or cache framework.
Training-time gains are not an acceptance claim for this inference campaign.
Verification selectors below name acceptance work to be added by their rows; they are not claims that tests already exist or passed.
Use cmd/plan or the landing gate to execute row verifiers so missing tests and skips are rejected as vacuous evidence.
Hermetic and small-device parity belongs to the landing gate; full weight loads, quality sets and performance runs belong to the model-tagged improvement cycle.
Production syntax-node counts below are planning estimates for new behavior, not measured performance targets; narrow them when the first implementation diff establishes the required scope.

steps.rationale:
SQA-283 (6): the refusals left are weights missing or not matching their recorded hash, an architecture with no prototype, and an absent remote key, each naming what is missing. Verification and activation stay; neither gates a run.
Decided by recommendation: refuse only where an activation's own location now holds other bytes, naming both digests, and run a merely remembered path with a reason. internal/modelcli/open_claimed_test.go:188-198 asserts replaced bytes run, against this step, and changes with it. Only llama, qwen2 and qwen3_5 map from a directory, 3 of 137 prototypes, so a closure of 'an architecture with no prototype' must also name a prototype with no directory mapping; funding more mappings, and media tasks, which still need an active recipe, are rows of their own. Pass the context to loadGGUFFacts (internal/modelrecipe/loaded_program.go:203,212), since the loader's hash ignores cancellation. Delete the dead check at derived_program.go:71-74.

steps.rationale:

Held-out readings take the same path: results land in EvaluationsByRecipe (:375), and a verdict's base reading is credited to every served recipe of the model (:1092-1094).

budget.reason: JavaScript only; no production Go grows.

steps.title: Render any line ending without locking up the tab
steps.rationale:
Reproduced again at 675d61b80 with the real md.js in Node. A line that opens a heading or fence and holds CR, U+2028 or U+2029 after the marker matches no pattern (internal/server/webui/md.js:149,166), while the paragraph guard accepts it (md.js:190-191), so the position never advances: 5 million nodes in 1.5 seconds. Plain CRLF text, lists and tables are safe. The only md() caller is composer.js:237 and a restore reaches it through mod/chat.js:1069, so a reload repeats the lock-up.
md() normalizes CR, CRLF, U+2028 and U+2029 at its top, and the paragraph branch always advances at least one line.
While the file is open, stop an unclosed [ costing quadratic time (md.js:62,70): 160,000 of them took 7.2 s against a stub DOM, 40,000 about 0.5 s, and a model stuck repeating is a realistic source.
Serves: failure-rate as a person meets it; a reload repeats the lock-up today.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: browser cases for each line ending and for a long unclosed bracket.
Batch: web interface lane.

steps.title: Keep each agent's history under that agent
steps.rationale:
selected is read before the await and again after it (internal/server/webui/mod/agent.js:131,145), and the same happens with agentPicker.value (mod/chat.js:993,998). Open has no busy guard (agent.js:93), so switching agents before a reply saves A's transcript as B's, and it goes out with B's next turn.
Capture the agent once in a constant before the request.
The same switch hides Stop: renderChat calls setBusy(!active) during a turn (agent.js:155, composer.js:829), so Send shows and a send returns silently at agent.js:129. Keep the busy state across a switch.
After a reload the picked agent's stored thread is not restored (mod/chat.js:145-150,771), so a second agent answers with no memory while the store holds its turns. Restore on a pick.
Serves: correct conversations.
Disappears: the second read.
Evidence: a browser test that switches mid-reply and keeps Stop.
Batch: web interface lane.

steps.title: Show every error a person's action produced
steps.rationale:
A Cancel that returns an error leaves a disabled button until the operation ends and no message (internal/server/webui/workflow.js:417-422,454), and evaluation Cancel has the same fault with no try (mod/evaluations.js:114-116). Invalid tool arguments throw outside the try (composer.js:928,951,955), Execute and Approve have no catch (composer.js:970-971), and a manifest read error on a Chat click shows nothing (boot.js:904,1371,939,1384).
boot.js:41 turns a non-JSON 200 into null, and boot.js:257 reports any TypeError as an unreachable server, including a bug in the page's own code (reproduced with the real readJSON and friendlyError).
Mark fetch failures once in tracked (boot.js:57-60) rather than reading err.name at :257, since browsers word that TypeError differently. readJSON keeps an empty body as null.
Serves: a person can tell what went wrong.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the existing stubs extended to workflow and evaluation Cancel.
Batch: web interface lane.

steps.title: Bound what a long session costs the browser
steps.rationale:
Reported by the review, unmeasured: tool output grows through textContent += with a scroll per piece (composer.js:307-308), restore renders each message twice (mod/chat.js:1069,1073), the chat DOM has no cap, and each operation event aborts the previous detail read (operations_shell.js:242,309,315) where mod/inbox.js:60-64 keeps one read and one queued.
Tool output is bounded at 64 MiB (internal/artifact/content.go:11), and only mod/chat.js:768 passes subscribe, so the Agent tab never streams it.
Measure first on a long conversation. Then use scrollSoon (composer.js:229), which fixed this class for tokens, set the response fields before the first render so the second goes (chat.js:1073 exists to draw the head), cap the live DOM and reuse the inbox's pattern.
Serves: browser memory and responsiveness in long sessions.
Disappears: the double render.
Evidence: DOM node count and heap before and after, one long-conversation fixture.

items.title: Repair proxy, agent and provider defects in the served path

budget.reason: Estimate after the 675d61b80 recheck: agent-attempts 120, child-exit 220, provider-listing 150, one-address-list 110, public-routes 50, session-list 150. The row's filed 500 did not hold the wider fixes.

steps.title: Notice a model server that exited
steps.rationale:
Process has no liveness (internal/modelswap/supervisor.go:25-32), and an exited child stays current (:147-149), so the proxy answers 502 until a different model is requested, or until the idle timer if -idle is set (default 0, cmd/swap/main.go:41). Acquire also holds s.mu through Launch and Ready (:123,179-189), so Status waits for a whole load. Both reproduced.
The launcher holds the exit channel (launcher.go:153-180), which carries one value then closes and has two readers (:196,233). Expose it, drop an exited child, and move the load outside the lock.
The plain fix alone is wrong: with the load outside the lock Status answers false during a load, routeServable returns errNothingServes (proxy.go:249-255), and a model-less request reaches the idle shell (proxy.go:126-130) instead of queuing. Status reports the loading servable. Close stops a child that finishes after it, and a second Acquire queues rather than launches.
Serves: failure-rate and load-time.
Disappears: a restart by hand after a device fault.
Evidence: a fake process that exits, one that loads slowly, and a request during the load.
Batch: serving lane.

steps.title: Let an agent step be attempted again after an error or a restart
steps.rationale:
Three ways stop a session for good, and two are reproduced at 675d61b80.
A mutation after a restart: agent_workspace.go:126 runs ApproveMutation before :137 sets session.Ceiling, and RestoreSession restores none (internal/agentloop/coordinator.go:241), so :552 writes the serving recipe and :404 compares the agent definition. Inspect, restart or swap, then approve: 'preflight binds different action facts', then 'attempt stimulus boundary already differs' for good. Set the ceiling first, inside the session lock, since :137 is also written outside it against the read at coordinator.go:558.
A tool error: Steps advances only on success (coordinator.go:214-221), so the next try reuses callID (:150) at a fixed ordinal and a moved head (:528), and internal/runrecord/attempt_stimulus.go:85-89 refuses it. The ordinal is fixed at five sites (coordinator.go:394,477,549,584,615). A restored session must find its next ordinal from the store, since a counter on Session is lost.
A refused approved step: coordinator.go:347 publishes before :130 refuses, since ApproveMutation has no manuals check, so a mutation outside the agent's manuals takes the ordinal. The page's list prevents this, the API does not.
Receipts close on the request context (coordinator.go:192,209,217) and the store refuses a cancelled one (internal/overgodb/store.go:628), so a disconnect leaves a finished mutation marked running. Use WithoutCancel, as :199 already does.
Serves: agent sessions keep working.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a tool that returns an error then succeeds, a restored session approving a mutation, and a cancelled request.
Batch: serving lane.

steps.title: Send a provider key only to the endpoint it was declared for
steps.rationale:
GET /library/providers/models takes a caller's endpoint and environment variable name (internal/server/library_workspace.go:295-304) and sends the value as a bearer token (internal/remoterelay/listing.go:47). A cross-site request is refused (library_workspace.go:291), so what remains is a local client or a key holder sending OVERGO_HF_TOKEN anywhere.
Checking only the listing does not close this: /library/register with kind provider takes the same caller-chosen pair (mod/discovery.js:197, library_workspace.go:236), canonicalize requires only a non-empty name (remoteprovider/provider.go:75), and the relay then sends the value (remoterelay/generator.go:152).
Bind a variable to one endpoint at declaration, and refuse the server's own secrets, on both routes. The page lists before declaring (discovery.js:203-206), so a new key goes in a POST body with a field on the page. Four tests use undeclared pairs and change (library_listing_test.go:17, idle_shell_test.go:218, library_provider_models_cross_site_test.go:28,35).
Serves: keys stay with their provider.
Disappears: arbitrary environment reads.
Evidence: a refused undeclared pair on both routes.
Batch: serving lane.

steps.title: Keep one list of refused addresses and a bounded tool environment
steps.rationale:
internal/agenttool/security.go:26-29 admits 13 of the 23 prefixes internal/server/media_policy.go:372-385 refuses (measured), not the 4 first listed: 100.64/10, 198.18/15, 0/8, 64:ff9b::/96, 192.0.0/24, 192.0.2/24, 198.51.100/24, 203.0.113/24, 240/4, 100::/64, 2001::/23, 2001:db8::/32 and ff00::/8. 224.0.1.1, 239.1.1.1 and 255.255.255.255 are admitted too. One list serves both, and README.md:280-281 grows with it.
Argv tools inherit the whole environment (internal/agenttool/transport.go:197-202, Env nil at processcontrol/supervisor.go:80,93), provider keys included. The manual names what a tool receives, over a base of named constants, since Windows programs likely need SystemRoot and PATH (hypothesis, settled by an argv tool test). A Manual field takes omitzero so existing identities hold.
Serves: the agent boundary README states.
Disappears: privateAddress and its copy of the rule.
Evidence: one table over both callers.

steps.title: Make the catalog route match SECURITY.md
steps.rationale:

items.title: Make the commit rules hold for every harness and spend fewer commits

budget.reason: Estimate. The merge exemption goes; a Git hook and two landing rules are added.

steps.title: Remove the raw commit exemption during a merge
steps.rationale:
internal/guard/guard.go:278 allows raw git commit while MERGE_HEAD exists, and its comment (:327-330) says a merge cannot go through the gate. Merges do (skill.md:117, internal/landing/landing.go:302-325). The first check, TestGuardCorpus, passes today, so it proved nothing.
The guard's Bash rule names only git commit (:60): cherry-pick, merge --no-edit, revert, rebase and update-ref pass with no merge in progress (measured); commit-rules/git-hook closes those. OVERGO_COMMIT_GATE has no production writer, so its branch is dead (guard.go:31-33,278).
Serves: no unchecked commit.
Disappears: mergeInProgress, about 36 lines, and GateEnv.
Evidence: the corpus case reversed.

steps.title: Refuse a raw move of the trunk in Git itself
steps.rationale:
The guard is a Claude Code hook, and a non-Claude worker has only convention (cmd/loop/main.go:1-5,366-375). Since 2026-10-15 first-parent history holds 122 commits outside it, all touching only docs/sqa_findings.json, and 62 more with code came on codex/overgo_moss through the gated merge ddf213036: the row's own case.
A pre-commit hook is too weak. In a scratch repository on git 2.51.0, core.hooksPath pre-commit stopped plain git commit alone: --no-verify, merge --no-ff, cherry-pick, revert, rebase, update-ref and am all moved HEAD (measured). A reference-transaction hook refused all of them on main with exit 128, --no-verify included, passed a marked landing and passed other branches (measured). Use that, and let it pass register-only commits. Landings use commit-tree (internal/landing/landing.go:751).
.gitattributes holds no LFS filter, so core.hooksPath costs nothing there. Nothing in a checkout sets it and a fixture cannot prove the live repository has it, so a landing checks the setting.
Serves: the gate as the one code path, for any worker.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a fixture repository, each verb refused.

steps.title: Show every change to a row's check or count
steps.rationale:
A plan-only commit runs only the check (internal/landing/landing.go:216-218) and is judged by the plan it carries (:410), so acceptance is frozen for one commit. A change can raise its own count (landing.go:468, rules.go:61), which contradicts skill.md:39,149.

steps.rationale:
Of the last 600 master commits, 235 touch Go and 258 change only the plan, 43 percent, because a row must exist before its work (internal/landing/landing.go:441) and each count raise is a commit.
A row new in the change lands with it, judged by its own check, which must fail on the commit it builds on. That keeps the proof a frozen check gave.

items.title: Report invalid numbers on the device instead of hiding them

budget.reason: Estimate. Kernel source is reported and not counted; Go adds a refusal and fixtures. Output bits for finite input do not move.

steps.title: Keep NaN through the BF16 pack
steps.rationale:
f32_to_bf16 has no guard (kernels/cuda/ops_f32.cu:156-158), unlike bf16_round_f32 (:430). The GPU's default NaN 0x7FFFFFFF packs to 0x8000, which is minus zero, and 0xFFFFFFFF to 0x0000, so a fault becomes a plausible value. strata_prompt_gr.cuh:21-25 holds the same code.
Do not copy the host's guard: Float32ToBF16 packs 0x7F800001, 0x7F80FFFF and 0xFF800001 to an infinity (internal/tensor/dtype/bfloat16.go:8-11, measured). The pack must force a mantissa bit, on the device and on the host.
cmd/kernel-manifest/main.go:143-146 refuses a dependency listed under two modules, and ops_f32.cu and strata_qsa.cu are separate modules, so one shared header needs that rule changed; otherwise keep one pack a module with a test that holds them equal. Land after kernel-proof/include-scan, because strata_prompt_gr.cuh is pinned by nothing until then.
Serves: held-out-quality, by making numeric faults visible.
Disappears: the unguarded copy.
Evidence: NaN and signalling-NaN cases on the device and the host.
Batch: kernel lanes, with the other kernel steps of this row in one landing.

steps.title: Give attention one rule for NaN
steps.rationale:
A NaN sum meets five behaviours, not three. Skip, leaving the buffer's contents: attention_native_bf16_f32 and attention_tiled_bf16_f32 (ops_f32.cu:7200,12547; compiled setp.leu at ops_f32.ptx:68898,218646). Write NaN: attention_tiled_f32 (:6879), attention_fast_f32 (:6728). Write 0: attention_decode_combine_f32 (:6293), strata_attn_merge (strata_qsa.cu:1119). Multiply by an inverse of 0: attention_flash (:7464), strata_prompt_attn (strata_qsa.cu:1398). Leave the undivided accumulator: attention_online_finalize_f32 (:6574).
Every path writes the row and keeps the NaN, and a zero sum keeps its zero-division guard. ops_f32 is built with fast math, so the test reads bits, as strata_round_elementwise.cuh:241 says. Whether an output buffer is zero-filled before launch was not checked.
Serves: no stale values reaching the output.
Disappears: four of five behaviours.
Evidence: one planted NaN channel for every kernel listed.
Batch: kernel lanes.

steps.title: Refuse what the device sampler cannot honor
steps.rationale:
strata_sampler.cuh:153-157 ignores min_keep: MinP 0.1 with MinKeep 5 stays on the round, where the host keeps 5 (internal/sampling/sampler.go:834-835). top_p and typical_p of 0 pass on a named chain and differ from the host: 1 token against all 8 over 400 seeds, since internal/sampling/order.go:73-75 idles the stage on an unnamed chain, and serving always names one (runtime_policies.json:36,86, internal/server/server.go:983). The table needs both cases, and each goes to the host path (internal/inference/strata_round_generate.go:67,73-76).
A NaN or infinite row must return an error as the host does (sampler.go:386,1180; -Inf is a legal ban there, but the device has no bias path, so a flagged -Inf is a fault). The device returns a token today, and greedy gives token 0 when every logit is NaN (strata_round_elementwise.cuh:235).
The check already runs and is thrown away. Each window runs strata_logits_nonfinite on bits (internal/cuda/executor/strata_round_window.go:589) into a mapped buffer (strata_round.go:223), and nothing reads r.nonfinite. Read it after the sync (strata_round_run.go:286-293). That covers greedy and sampled rows with no kernel edit and no new device read. Do not take a flag from the top-k maximum: a NaN never enters that list (strata_sampler.cuh:312-313), so a row with one NaN has a finite maximum.
Serves: a request gets the distribution it declared, and a numeric fault ends as an error.
Disappears: an unread buffer's waste.
Evidence: a host table and one device row of NaN.
Batch: serving lane; no kernel change.

steps.title: Stop reading past a tensor, and read an aligned word once
steps.rationale:
load_i32_unaligned always loads aligned[1] (ops_f32.cu:67-73, 14 callers from :7619 to :9729; both loads are in the compiled code, ptx:91866-91868), so at a tensor's last word it reads 4 bytes past. Each weight is its own exact-size allocation (internal/modeldevice/device_load.go:266,292), so a tensor end can be an allocation end, and Q4_K [4096, 16384] is exactly 36 MiB.
Load the second word only when the address is unaligned, as strata_mtp.cuh:72 does. A device test cannot force an unmapped neighbour (internal/cuda/driver has no address-reserve binding) and would pass on the unfixed kernel, so the check reads the compiled code. A device fault here is still a hypothesis.
Decode reads are this code's main cost, so time the product kernels in a fixture before and after: hypothesis, half the loads on aligned input. Q8_0 words are aligned in odd blocks only (offset 2, stride 34).
SQA-246 joins this step: launch_strata_native_mmvq.go:99-107 has no bound on the flattened size, the one open P3 on a production arithmetic path.
Serves: throughput, and no read outside an allocation.
Disappears: one load per word on aligned input.
Evidence: the compiled check, and the fixture's rate at unchanged bits.

steps.rationale:

steps.title: Judge a quality decline against the level the model held
steps.rationale:
Quality is outside repeated (internal/scorecard/record.go:278), so it is compared only with the newest reading (:325-343). With no offsetting gains, five lost cases give a tail of 0.03125 against pairedTail 0.02275 (record.go:832,859; six lost cases file), and Propose only prints it (cmd/loop/improve.go:292-295). steps.rationale:

The present rule has a reason (:769-773): a fix closes the cell with its first success. With a window, scorecard-failing rows stay open (record.go:779, cmd/validate/scorecard.go:153-155) until failures age out, at about one attempt a cycle, and a fix could not land by its own check. So failures before the fix's commit leave the count once it passes.

items.title: Hold training's optimizer to what it states

budget.reason: Estimate. A finite check, two state fields and a rate count in existing owners.

steps.title: Stop a training step on a non-finite direction
steps.rationale:
norm < guard is false for NaN (internal/hostoptimizer/newton_schulz.go:63; internal/optimizer/newton_schulz_cuda_windows.go:254), so one NaN makes the group and its momentum NaN. Checkpoints catch that at publish (internal/trainingprogram/checkpoint.go:373) and route runs stop on the step (cmd/train/shared_run.go:90,93, with the misleading text 'carried no gradient'), but the dense token paths have no check (workflow.go:504, densecausal/train.go:103), so a NaN at step 1 spends every remaining step.
Momentum is written before any check (optimizer.go:106, muon_step_cuda_windows.go:90-95), so the stop must end the run. The guard refuses +Inf too: on the device a gradient of norm at or above about 1.85e19 gives normSquared +Inf, scale 0 and a silent zero update where the host steps normally (newton_schulz_cuda_windows.go:249-257, by reading).
Step has about 15 direct callers, so prefer a field on the step's result, checked at the two dense sites, about 40 nodes, over an error return, about 200. The norm is already read as a scalar, so no transfer is added. MOSS shares this guard and its route contains it.
Serves: hours not spent training a broken model.
Disappears: a misleading error text.
Evidence: a planted NaN gradient on the host and device paths.
Batch: training lanes.

steps.title: Record and judge the resident training schedule
steps.rationale:
Resident training runs 4+2 iterations in TF32 (internal/optimizer/newton_schulz_cuda_windows.go:218,225), used only by densecausaltrain/train_resident_cuda_windows.go:294; the host runs 8+2. Recomputed at rank 4096: update size 0.42 of the host's for a 1/i spectrum, 0.67 for exponential decay, 1.00 flat. The gap falls with rank: 1/i gives 0.53 at 2560, 0.80 at 896, Qwen2.5-0.5B's largest rank, 0.93 at 512, and 1/sqrt(i) gives 1.00 everywhere. Real spectra are unmeasured, so take a momentum SVD first.
Record schedule and precision in State, not Config: Config enters the session plan id and every seed (session_plan.go:84-90,126-144), and Restore compares it (optimizer.go:142). Add an oracle for 4+2, since newton_schulz_cuda_windows_test.go:106 compares only FP32, and compare descent at both on one fixture.
4+2 is matched and pinned: muon_step_cuda_windows.go:167 and dense_training_leadership_cuda_windows_test.go:30-31 hold optimizer:muon-4x2-tf32 by SHA, so a change rebaselines that test and TestCarbonMatchedAdaptiveLeadership. Keep whichever wins per unit time; if 4+2 stays, correct the scale rule. MOSS is not affected: it runs FP32 8+2 (muon_step_cuda_windows.go:299).
This lands before training-gaps/judged-proof: recording moves no number, but the decision can, and a no-gain result could otherwise reflect an unjudged update size.
Serves: throughput of training and honest rates.
Disappears: an unstated difference.
Evidence: loss per unit time at both schedules.

The reward path learned this (train_resident_cuda_windows.go:374-379).
Only the six GatherGradients callers can tell absent from zero; slab trainers cannot, and a present all-zero gradient still drifts. Stepper.Step has no group skip (stepper.go:5), so device steppers need a small API change. MOSS has no absent case: every projection needs a module (muon_step_cuda_windows.go:209).

steps.title: Freeze the comparison before any training
steps.rationale:
The experiment asks one question: does a small host encoder plus a trained projector give Qwen3.5-9B useful vision at far less card memory than a native vision model? Qwen3.5-9B peaks at 9.0 GiB, Qwen3.8-27B at 22.3 GiB.

A full-stack 9B step took about 3 min 4 s (docs/verification/qwen35-9b-fullstack-training-run.txt:87-90), so a thousand steps is about 51 hours; Qwen2.5-0.5B took 0.47 s a step. Include a floor (a constant answer) and a ceiling (27B).
Serves: held-out-quality and peak-device-memory.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: an acceptance record published before the first training step.
Batch: evaluation lane.
